title.narrative: Supporting DRR & Climate Action in TL through Independent Journalism & ATI

description.narrative:
This work plan is dedicated to strengthening the capacity of media outlets in Timor-Leste to better plan, coordinate, and report on natural disasters and the climate crisis more broadly. It will also enhance their ability to identify and counter climate mis/disinformation, collaborate with scientists, youth and environmental activists, and to apply UNESCO’s model plan for disaster risk reduction in their preparedness and response arrangements.
UNESCO will leverage its previous work with the press council and the association of journalists to finalize and implement the multisectoral communication protocols and emergency escalation mechanisms for ensuring access to information during disasters, especially for coastal and rural communities. The work plan will thus involve a variety of stakeholders, including media organizations, journalists, editors, and journalist associations, as well as the civil protection authority, meteorological and climate institutions, the Ministry of Social Communications, grassroots organizations, etc.
The activities under this work plan will be implemented in collaboration with the Sciences Sector to support coordinated, evidence-based disaster communication and risk reduction.
